name: e1-empty-magazine-bait
notes: The 'unresupplied bait' version of the refit trick: empty the magazines of the player's fleets at Earth so their SCV collapses (weapons without ammo count as inoperable), then see what the aliens send. A player would resupply before the attack arrives. Threat memory samples the fleets at load, before the drain, so the fixed AI remembers what they were.
expect: vanilla FAILS (attacks sized to the drained ~0 SCV); the fixed AI sizes attacks to the fleets' real strength
asserts: min([r['scv'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet', toSystem='Earth')] or [0]) >= events('inject')[0]['scvBefore']
